empty..rota/DECISIONS.md:
# Decisions

Hard boundaries for this project. Each entry is a commitment, not a preference — re-read before proposing changes that touch its area.

Use `/rota-decide` to capture a new decision. `/rota-work`, `/rota-debug`, `/rota-plan`, `/rota-refactor`, `/rota-review`, and `/rota-vision` consult this file when its topics are relevant.
empty..rota/KNOWLEDGE.md:
# Knowledge

Durable learnings captured from sessions — gotchas, conventions, constraints, and hard-won debugging insights. Grouped by topic, newest first within each topic.

Use `/rota-learn` at the end of a session to capture new learnings. `/rota-work` consults this file when its topics are relevant to the task.

## Glossary

_(no terms yet — use `/rota-learn --term <name>` to capture project terminology)_
empty..rota/MAP.md:
# Project map

AI-facing index of subsystems. Detail files live in `.rota/map/<name>.md` and are loaded on demand via `rota map query <name>`. The thin always-on summary in `CLAUDE.md` is regenerated by `rota map index`.

Write `.rota/map/<name>.md` files describing subsystems as you discover them. Cycle skills (`/rota-work`, `/rota-debug`) bump `touched:` post-cycle on subsystems whose key files or entry points overlap the cycle's changes.
